citation.title: The facial configuration in a sample of Chinese boys

curation.notes: Compared 2026-10-08: norms:compare a vs b exit 1, 3 differences (logs/task9a2-compare-<id>.log). Every mean and SD of both extractors re-read from the page images (PDF pp. 2-6 = journal pp. 20-24), and the settled file checked by script against a third, independent reading of the pages (the table in sets.test.ts). Decisions: (0) Source text normalised to one pattern giving table, page, row and column with sex and age (a and b worded it differently; prose only). (1) Gonial angle a same / b close -> close, points not stated (merge notes). Page images: PDF pp. 2-6 = journal pp. 20-24 (Tables I-VI), rendered at 2000 px.

caveats: Quoted second-hand from Moate & Darendeliler 2002 (Aust Orthod J 18:19-26, a compilation of published Chinese cephalometric norms), Table II; the original paper was not read. The compilation rounds every mean and SD to whole numbers (Lew's soft tissue to 0.5) and gives no landmark, plane or method definitions.
The compilation states no film scale or magnification for any study; assumed true size (owner ruling M-2).

Table II heads this column 'Yen11', but reference 11 is Lew et al. 1992; the column was identified by the author name against Moate's reference list (Yen 1973 is reference 13), as both extractors did.
The compilation's text does not describe this study's sample (size, age, selection or place); only its table column and its reference-list entry are given.
Boys per the title; Table II heads the column '11 Years, Male'.
Not entered (not catalogue measurements; no ratio computed): S-N (65 ± 4).
